patch_description:
The current program has lower validation accuracy (0.63) compared to prior program 2 (0.68). Key improvements in prior program 2 were:
1. Individual RY output preparation layer (not just shared phase)
2. Mixed gate types including CRY and CCRZ for better expressivity
3. More diverse three-qubit interactions

This edit implements:
1. Adds a mirror of the three-qubit ZZZ block with parameter sharing as recommended
2. Adds an explicit RY output layer (improving from prior 2 design)
3. Replaces one ZZZ with CCRZ for structural diversity
4. Adds CRY gates in the two-qubit entanglement layer for better expressivity

This targets the validation accuracy gap while maintaining reasonable parameter efficiency through strategic sharing.
